title: [SEC6] Good: No framework, no CDN — minimal attack surface
description:
The web client is vanilla JavaScript with zero external dependencies:
- No React, Vue, Angular, or other framework
- No Tailwind CDN or external CSS
- No third-party libraries loaded from CDN
- Single index.html with single app.js module (ES6 import syntax)
- All styling inline in style.css

This reduces attack surface:
- No compromised npm package can inject code
- No CDN compromise can poison assets
- No framework version bugs in the hot path
- Fewer bytes to download (single binary deployment)
- Faster startup

Phase 1 scope (3000-4000 lines) doesn't need the abstraction overhead of a framework. Code is direct and auditable. If complexity later demands it, migration path exists—but starting minimal was the right call.
